request.text: Here. Bread's yesterday's, but it's bread. Keep off the ridges today. There were men in grey up there at first light, asking at every fire. I've seen nothing! I sell needles, that's all! Bones, traveller? Day 9. Land. A bay where they fish by night and nothing comes for them. Day 14. Halfway, by the stars. It's back. It follows the lamp, so the lamp's out. It follows anyway.
request.voice_description: Native English, British, a plain everyday Midlands accent. Male, 30-40. Excellent quality. Persona: an ordinary working man of the roads and the coast, a herder, a pedlar, a fisherman, a sailor keeping a log. Emotion: plain, friendly, wary, quick to fear, honest. A clear, natural, mid-pitched voice, conversational and unpolished; easy to listen to, with no strong character of its own, so it can be many men.
